data.name: Terrain Master ATV
data.shortDescription: Adds fully functional multiplayer compatible ATVs to the game.
data.description:
Adds a multiplayer compatible, fully functioning, gas powered ATV that you can ride around island.


### Features:


- Supports 1 passenger. Kelvin, Virginia or 1 player can ride along.
- Built for speed and tricky terrain. This ATV can be parked on any slope without sliding away, handles slopes amazingly well and moves faster then golf carts.
- Capable of jumping to help navigate tricky terrain.
- Doesn't damage player made structures. 
- Gas powered. Ideal for nighttime traveling if you know where to get gas.

### Disadvantages it has vs the golf cart

- No radio. 
- No gps.
- Larger hitbox
- Sinks if it lands in deep water.
- If you don't know where to get gas, you may get stranded without it more easily.
- Less light. However lights remain on even when out of the ATV.

### Where to find:

Look near human encampments for ATVs. If you want to test it out, press Shift P to spawn one in. Clients cannot spawn one in multiplayer.

### Where do I get Gasoline?

Youll find jerrycans with gas in cannibal and human camps all over the island. Pick them up and bring them to the ATV where the light bulb is and press E to add gas. All ATVs start with 200 gas. Each gas tank restores 100+ fuel. If you run out of fuel you will be automatically ejected. Fuel respawns in 20 minutes. In multiplayer fuel tanks are consumed by whoever grabs the fuel tank first.

### How does it handle enemies?

The player is immune while in the ATV, but touching cannibals takes away 5 fuel which can get you ejected. Crashing into trees costs you 2 fuel.

https://youtu.be/eYJeHFEZHmY

Note: The download only contains the manifest, license and credits. To get access to this mod dm RegiRockn'roll in the SOTF discord to see if you qualify for early access.

data.name: Immersive Companion Injuries (Beta)
data.shortDescription: Provides a more immersive injury and healing system to companions.
data.description:
I always found it very immersion breaking how Kelvin and Virginia can be healed from a potentially life threatening injury by just holding E for a short time. This mod addresses that by making there be genuine consequences for your companion getting injured and providing an immersive solution to healing them.

### What this mod does

Whenever Kelvin or Virginia fall into an injured state they must be brought to a bed and set to rest for 1 real time hour(customizable). They no longer heal and revive on their own. After sleeping for 1 hour they will awake at full health.

You also have the option of assigning permadeath to Kelvin or Virginia if you don't do it in a certain time in mod configs. THIS IS OFF BY DEFAULT.

### How to bring Kelvin and/or Virginia to a bed.

There is a new icon that appears on Kelvin and Virginia in an injured state. Hold E to pick them up and Control Y to drop them in the nearest beds. When you are close enough you will get a notification and a green light indicating you can place them on the bed. Double beds can hold 2 companion npcs. You can also press Control U to set down Kelvin and Virgina anywhere. They will remain in their injured state. If you don't like these keybinds it can be changed in mod configs.

### Does this work with multiple Kelvin's and Virginia's

Yes.

### What happens if the bed Kelvin and/or Virginia is on gets destroyed or moved?

They will fall to the ground. However there is a known bug that if Kelvin or Virginia are on a bed and it gets destroyed, any other companion npcs cannot be properly placed in bed. Restart the game if this happens.

### Can Kelvin and Virginia be hurt while in bed?

No.

### Editing Health

You can edit health in the mod configs if you think they are too weak.

### Multiplayer

Only works as the host in multiplayer right now.

https://youtu.be/b0EtHwrG7RY

If you want to see a video on how this mod works, look here.

data.name: Kelvin Can Attack + Spotlights
data.shortDescription: Adds a buildable mounted spear launchers, spotlights and a kick attack to Kelvin. Prevents fleeing.
data.description:
The time has come. No longer is Kelvin just a worker you give orders to. Now he can pack the heart with new mounted weapon systems! This mod allows you to build mounted spear launchers and spotlights to light the way.

## What the mounted spear launchers do:

They will fire spears at any enemy Kelvin encounters. Friendly targets won't trigger the spear launchers to be fired. However be careful. If you are in the line of sight when Kelvin is firing it can hurt you and Virginia. 

Kelvin also no longer runs away from enemies. However he may still cower sometimes.

## Kelvin's Melee Kick

If an enemy is nearby the kelvin will kick the enemy. By default the kick damage is very low. I recommend setting it to around 150-300. You can also adjust Kelvin's health. I recommend setting it to around 500-1000.

## The Spotlights

You can also build spotlights on Kelvin that will light the way as he walks around.

## How to build the spear launchers and spotlights

All spear launchers and spotlights structures in the game now come with a new icon. Bring Kelvin within 10 range of a spear launcher or spotlight then hold E to build it in the nearest Kelvin. The original structure will be destroyed and rebuilt on Kelvin. NOTE: In order to build spotlights on kelvin you must FIRST have built a spear launcher on him. Then save the game to keep them.

## Does the work for multiple kelvins?

Yes. When setting them up though it works based on the nearest Kelvin.


## Multiplayer: 

Only is adjustable as host to prevent game disruption. Enemies killed and the spears made sync, but not the structures on Kelvin themselves.

https://youtu.be/A8rrwWk0x2I

This video shows you step by step how to set the spear launchers and spotlights up on Kelvin.

#### If you want to remove existing mounted spear launchers.

Press Shift +R. Removes them on the nearest Kelvin.

data.name: Coop Server Tools(Beta)
data.shortDescription: Allows for hiding maps, gps and indicators icons in coop. Tells a server host the modlist a client is using.
data.description:
This mod has 2 import features:

#### Shows you a list mods a client is using

If someone also has this mod and joins your server you will get a list of the mods they are using on the Redloader Console.

#### Allows you to disable player location indicators for everyone in coop.

This includes all maps, gps icons, player usernames etc. Your location can be truly secret. This is excellent if you want to do coop pvp.

#### How to use this mod

First find someone you trust to do coop with you. Tell them to install this mod. Once they are in game check the Redloader console that allows loads with the game. If they have this mod installed you should see something like:
[CoopServerTools] mysteamfriend has CoopServerTools installed!

Followed by a list of all mods they are using. You will also get a notification in game shortly after they join.

If you don't see their name show up it means they don't have it installed. If you see they are using a list of mods that you don't want used on the server at that point you can decide the appropriate action.

#### Can clients edit the settings?

Not if they have this mod installed. If they have this mod installed it will override any attempts to change the host settings. However if you see someone running Unity Explorer or GPSRemover tell them to remove it before the game continues.

data.name: Virginia Hug Emote
data.shortDescription: Restores the cut Virginia hug interaction with the player.
data.description:
This mod restores a cut Virginia Hug interaction with the player. By default you also gain a stamina recovery buff for 5 minutes when you do this and it grants you extra virginia sentiment. Virginia will also giggle shortly after being hugged with one of 20 voicelines.

### How to hug Virginia

Stand next to Virginia and press Shift+O. If you want to stop the hug press Shift+U. This will also cancel the stamina buff.

### You can customize the following in this mod:

1. Whether or not the player also triggers an animation during the hug.  For some users they may prefer this off to avoid clipping.
2. How loud her giggle voice after hugs is.
3. Whether or not there is a stamina buff.
4. How much stamina recovery you get from it if any. 
5. How long the stamina buff lasts(5 minutes by default).

### Other things to note:

1. Endnight cut this interaction from the game because they were worried it would cause problems since it locks the player in place. This mod solves this by allowing you to interrupt it at any time.

2. This is not a perfect restoration. I could not find a corresponding hug animation on the player so I had to improvise by using one of the other player animations. And to ensure Virginia is running smoothly after the hug ends, I had to reinitialize her AI which results in a temporary stutter. 

3. The voice lines found in this mod are replaceable wav files. In case you want to use something else. None of the clips were generated with AI.

### Virginia will not hug you if:

1. She is scared 
2. Nearly dead or dead.
3. In Combat
4. Sleeping
5. On Fire

### Multiplayer:

Now tested. Only works for the host in peer to peer games right now. However when the host hugs Virginia it syncs to other players.

I plan to allow the host to determine if they want to allow clients to hug.

data.name: Vanilla Armsys
data.shortDescription: Brings the forest Armsy sounds to Armysies in this game and they cut trees.
data.description:
Many of you may remember that in the first game Armysies cut down trees and emit a loud roar from a distance. Those behaviors are absent in the Sons of the forest versions. This mod rectifies that by bringing them back! 

You can customize the following in Mod>Configs:

1. How often the roar sound plays.
2. How loud the roar sound is.
3. How far it can be heard from.

And if you just want the tree cutting or roar, but not the other you can disable the roars and treecutting in the config options. 

Multiplayer

Purposely disabled client side in multiplayer games to prevent gameplay disruption. I haven't tested if it works in multiplayer yet. But its probably works client side if the host. Ill look into adding multiplayer syncing in the future.

Note: This mod doesn't make them spawn earlier. Use VailSpawnControl or Raid Customizer for that.
